item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 01/Dec/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. A band of clouds will also bring one or two rain patches to the region. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China tomorrow night to early Wednesday. It will be slightly cooler in the morning over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. With the band of clouds thinning out gradually, the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas in the latter part of this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Koto will linger over the central part of the South China Sea today. It will then move towards the vicinity of the southern part of Vietnam and weaken gradually in the next couple of days. On the other hand, Tropical Cyclone Senyar will move across the southern part of the South China Sea today and dissipate gradually.
